edges.reason: initialize assigns the name_ parameter into the _name state variable
initialize assigns the symbol_ parameter into the _symbol state variable
initialize reads msg.sender to build the upgrader assignment
upgrader state variable is set from the caller-controlled value in initialize
setUpgrader copies the upgrader_ parameter into the upgrader assignment
setUpgrader overwrites the privileged upgrader state variable
add writes the ipfsHash parameter into the ipfsHashes mapping
add uses nextTokenId as the ipfsHashes mapping key
the nextTokenId value feeds the increment operation
the incremented result is written back into the nextTokenId state variable
local tokenId is assigned from the nextTokenId state variable in add
local tokenId is returned by add as the newly created token id
tokenURI reads the ipfsHashes mapping using the tokenId parameter
onlyUpgrader reads the upgrader state variable for its authorization check
onlyUpgrader compares msg.sender against upgrader
onlyOwner reads the _owner state variable for its authorization check
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the current owner
onlyUpgrader modifier gates execution of setUpgrader
onlyUpgrader modifier gates execution of _authorizeUpgrade
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of add
the authorized upgrade path proceeds from _authorizeUpgrade into the delegatecall step
UUPS upgrade delegatecalls into the implementation contract, transferring execution control to external code

normalization_plan.reason: name_ is a transient initializer parameter consumed only by the initialize function when writing _name
symbol_ is a transient initializer parameter consumed only by the initialize function when writing _symbol
ipfsHash is a transient parameter used only inside add to write into ipfsHashes
tokenId is a read-only lookup key used only inside tokenURI
upgrader_ is a transient parameter used only by setUpgrader to update the upgrader state
local tokenId is a short-lived return carrier created and consumed entirely within add
